summary: Third-party executable Provider plugin binding Tripo3D to the built-in tripo-h3.1 and tripo-auto-rig model Cards. Contributes zero cards.
context_hints: This plugin never contributes a Card. tripo-h3.1 and tripo-auto-rig are Clash built-in Cards owned by a separate integration task in packages/shared-types; this package only ships the Provider, the two model-provider bindings, and the executor that serves them.

tripo-h3.1 is one Card for both text-to-3D and image-to-3D: the executor reads the invocation references for a reference in slot 'image' and calls POST /v3/generation/image-to-model when present, otherwise POST /v3/generation/text-to-model with the prompt. tripo-auto-rig always calls POST /v3/animations/rig against a required reference in slot 'model'.

Every upstream generation and rig request is pinned to the exact model version fixed by contract: v3.1-20260211 for text/image-to-model, v1.0-20240301 (biped) for auto-rig. Auto-rig always requests rig_type=biped, spec=mixamo, out_format=glb -- no other rig topology is offered.

The Provider account carries a `region` choice, `international` (default) or `china`, resolved once per submit/poll to a fixed host: openapi.tripo3d.ai/v3 or openapi.tripo3d.com/v3 -- see src/tripo-region.ts. Region is an account/plugin-store fact, never a model Card parameter, so neither binding file mentions it. An illegal stored region is a structured, non-retryable ProviderExecutionError (invalid_request) raised before any request is built; there is no automatic fallback to the other host and no cross-region key trial within one invocation. There is no Provider account baseUrl override: region is the only account/plugin-store fact that selects a host.

Image and model references are resolved through context.reference before any Provider request is built. A provider-url or a bytes/executor-url payload uploaded through Tripo's own POST /v3/files is what reaches Tripo -- a clash-asset:// URI is never sent upstream. Upload, submit, and poll for one invocation always share the single base URL resolved from that invocation's account.

The v1 request surface forwards exactly five card parameters to Tripo: pbr, textureQuality (texture_quality), geometryQuality (geometry_quality), faceLimit (face_limit), autoSize (auto_size). No other Tripo parameter is exposed yet.

Task polling is one shared GET /v3/tasks/{task_id} regardless of route, called against the same account-resolved base URL as submit. queued/running stay an accepted poll; success completes with a model/gltf-binary media output; failed and cancelled become terminal Provider failures. HTTP failure and a non-zero envelope code are both handled, and each is distinct from a task-level failed status.

subdirectories.providers: Tripo3D Provider declaration, secure API-key form, and the region choice field (international default, china).
subdirectories.bindings: model-provider-binding documents routing tripo-h3.1 and tripo-auto-rig to this Provider.
subdirectories.src: Typed stdio entrypoint, Tripo v3 HTTP client, region-to-base-URL resolution, reference resolution, and the submit/poll executor.

key_files.manifest.json: Versioned executable package and contribution declarations; contributes.cards is empty by contract.
key_files.providers/tripo.json: Provider metadata, Bearer API-key authentication form with the region choice (international default -> openapi.tripo3d.ai, china -> openapi.tripo3d.com), and default asset-input representations.
key_files.bindings/tripo-h3.1.json: Binds tripo-h3.1 to Tripo's v3.1-20260211 text/image-to-model routes.
key_files.bindings/tripo-auto-rig.json: Binds tripo-auto-rig to Tripo's v1.0-20240301 biped auto-rig route.
key_files.src/tripo-region.ts: Pure region-to-base-URL resolution (international/china), throwing a structured ProviderExecutionError on an unrecognised region.
key_files.src/tripo-client.ts: Pure Tripo v3 HTTP layer: request builders, envelope/HTTP error mapping, submit, task poll, file upload -- every call accepts the caller-resolved baseUrl.
key_files.src/tripo-adapter.ts: Route selection (text-to-model vs image-to-model vs auto-rig), account region resolution, reference resolution, and the submit/poll Executor.
